 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Kings are coming off a 3-2 loss to the Calgary Flames, their 4th straight loss. In their 7-game homestand, the Kings won only 2 games and lost 5, and tonight they are on the road for their next 5 games as they look to turn their season around. The Bruins enter this game on a 2-game losing skid and are looking to get back in the win column.

 Game Notes
 The Kings will be without forward Artemi Panarin tonight, as he is scratched for a personal family matter. The Kings have also scratched Cody Ceci and Samuel Helenius. The Kings also get Gustafsson back after he missed 3 games with an undisclosed injury.
 The Bruins will be without James Hagens (back), and they have also scratched Matthew Poitras, Frederic Brunet, and Jonathan Aspirot.
 For the goaltending matchup, it will likely be Darcy Kuemper for the Kings and Michael DiPietro for the Bruins . Kuemper has allowed 10 goals in his last 2 starts, so he is looking to bounce back. DiPietro has won his last 4 starts, and he looks to continue his winning ways.
 The Kings are set to take on the Bruins at 7 PM ET.
